title: Greendale registration service
subtitle: A focused assessment of correctness, operational risk, and maintainability.

summary.headline: The core flow is small and readable, but retry handling can duplicate enrollments.
paragraphs: The service keeps ownership boundaries clear and has useful integration coverage.
Release should wait until idempotency and cancellation propagation are addressed.

findings.title: Retries can create duplicate enrollments
findings.summary: The write path checks for an existing row before starting the transaction.
details: Two concurrent requests can both pass the check and insert the same student-course pair.

evidence.label: Impact
evidence.text: Students may be billed twice and occupy two seats.

evidence.label: Cause
evidence.text: The database does not enforce the domain identity.

findings.recommendation: Add a unique constraint for the pair and treat the conflict as a successful retry.

findings.title: Cancellation stops at the HTTP boundary
findings.summary: Repository calls use a background context instead of the request context.
details: Timed-out requests can keep a database connection occupied until the query finishes.
findings.recommendation: Pass the request context through the service and repository layers.

findings.title: Operational errors lose useful context
findings.summary: Several returned errors omit the student and course identifiers.
findings.recommendation: Wrap boundary errors with the operation and stable identifiers.

sections.title: Strong foundations
sections.intro: These parts reduce the cost and risk of the recommended fixes.

cards.title: Clear ownership
cards.body: HTTP, domain, and persistence concerns stay in separate packages without ceremonial wrappers.

cards.title: Useful integration tests
cards.body: The suite exercises real transaction behavior and makes the concurrency gap easy to cover.

scope: Read the HTTP, domain, and persistence paths.
Ran the repository test and lint commands.
Did not assess production database configuration or deployment manifests.
actions: Enforce enrollment identity in the database and add a concurrent retry test.
Propagate request cancellation through the repository boundary.
footer: Prepared as an evidence-led engineering review.
